tasks.title: Project Setup and Configuration
tasks.description: Initialize the Next.js 15 project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components. Configure ESLint, Prettier, and set up the project structure.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Next.js 15 project with App Router: `npx create-next-app@latest dietaibest --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app`
2. Install and configure Shadcn UI: `npx shadcn-ui@latest init`
3. Set up project structure with directories for components, hooks, utils, types, and API services
4. Configure TypeScript with strict mode in tsconfig.json
5. Set up ESLint and Prettier with recommended rules
6. Configure Tailwind CSS with custom theme tokens for the design system
7. Create a base layout with responsive breakpoints (mobile < 640px, tablet 641-1024px, desktop > 1024px)
8. Set up Git repository with appropriate .gitignore
9. Configure Vercel deployment settings
10. Install required dependencies: `npm install next-intl@3.0.0 react-query@5.0.0 framer-motion@11.0.0 zod@3.22.4`
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify project builds without errors: `npm run build`
2. Ensure TypeScript type checking passes: `npm run typecheck`
3. Validate ESLint configuration: `npm run lint`
4. Test responsive layout rendering on different viewport sizes using Playwright
5. Verify Shadcn UI components render correctly

tasks.title: Authentication System Implementation
tasks.description: Implement authentication using Supabase Auth and next-auth with Google OAuth integration. Set up JWT handling with httpOnly cookies and silent refresh mechanism.
tasks.details:
1. Install required packages: `npm install @supabase/supabase-js@2.39.0 next-auth@4.24.5`
2. Create Supabase client utility in `lib/supabase.ts`
3. Configure next-auth with Supabase provider in `app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts`
4. Set up Google OAuth provider in Supabase dashboard and next-auth config
5. Implement JWT storage in httpOnly cookies
6. Create authentication context provider in `contexts/AuthContext.tsx`
7. Build sign-in and sign-up forms with email validation
8. Implement magic link authentication flow
9. Create `/auth/refresh` endpoint for silent JWT refresh
10. Add authentication middleware to protect routes
11. Implement sign-out functionality
12. Create AuthGuard component for protected routes
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test authentication context with React Testing Library
2. Test sign-in form validation with various inputs
3. Mock Supabase responses to test successful and failed authentication
4. Test JWT refresh mechanism with expired tokens
5. Verify Google OAuth flow redirects correctly
6. Test protected routes redirect unauthenticated users
7. Verify sign-out clears cookies and session state

tasks.title: Multi-language Support
tasks.description: Implement internationalization (i18n) with next-intl to support English, Polish, and Spanish languages. Create language switcher and ensure all UI strings are translatable.
tasks.details:
1. Install next-intl: `npm install next-intl@3.0.0`
2. Configure next-intl in `next.config.js` with supported locales (EN, PL, ES)
3. Create locale files in `messages/{locale}.json` for each supported language
4. Set up language detection middleware in `middleware.ts`
5. Create a language switcher component in `components/LanguageSwitcher.tsx`
6. Implement locale persistence using cookies
7. Extract all UI strings into translation keys
8. Create a custom hook `useTranslation` for accessing translations
9. Implement locale-specific formatting for dates, numbers, and currencies
10. Add language preference to user profile in Supabase
11. Ensure all dynamic content (errors, notifications) uses translation keys
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test language switcher changes locale correctly
2. Verify translations load for each supported language
3. Test locale persistence across page refreshes
4. Verify date and number formatting follows locale conventions
5. Test language preference syncs with user profile
6. Verify all UI components display translated content
7. Test fallback behavior for missing translations

13. Implement batch processing for multiple ingredients and meal plan requests

subtasks.title: Create Header Component Structure
subtasks.description: Set up the basic structure for the Header component with placeholder content and proper TypeScript typing.
subtasks.details: Create `components/navigation/Header.tsx` as a server component. Define the component structure with appropriate props interface. Include placeholder sections for logo, main navigation, language switcher, and authentication controls. Set up responsive container with proper styling using Tailwind CSS.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify component renders without errors and has proper structure for child components.

subtasks.title: Implement MainNav Component
subtasks.description: Create the MainNav component for primary navigation links with proper routing integration.
subtasks.details: Develop `components/navigation/MainNav.tsx` component. Create a navigation item type definition in `types/navigation.ts`. Implement NavigationMenu from ShadCN UI. Add routes to Dashboard, Recipes, Meal Plans, and Shopping Lists. Include active state indicators for current route. Ensure proper aria attributes for accessibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test navigation links with correct routing and active state indicators.

subtasks.title: Create UserDropdown Component
subtasks.description: Implement the dropdown menu for authenticated users with account management options.
subtasks.details: Build `components/navigation/UserDropdown.tsx` component. Use ShadCN UI DropdownMenu component. Include user avatar display. Add menu items for profile, settings, and logout. Implement proper focus management. Ensure keyboard navigation support.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test dropdown opens/closes correctly and all menu items function properly.

subtasks.title: Develop MobileMenu Component
subtasks.description: Create a responsive mobile menu for small screen devices.
subtasks.details: Implement `components/navigation/MobileMenu.tsx`. Use ShadCN UI Sheet component for slide-out drawer. Create hamburger menu toggle button. Implement collapsible sections for nested navigation. Ensure proper z-index management. Add smooth animations for opening/closing.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test mobile menu on various screen sizes and verify all navigation options are accessible.

subtasks.title: Integrate Authentication Status
subtasks.description: Connect header navigation with authentication system to show different options based on user status.
subtasks.details: Import and use the existing `useAuth` hook to determine user authentication status. Implement conditional rendering logic in Header component. Show UserDropdown for authenticated users. Display sign in/sign up buttons for unauthenticated users. Ensure proper type safety for authentication-dependent UI elements.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test both authenticated and unauthenticated states to verify correct UI elements are displayed.

subtasks.title: Add Internationalization Support
subtasks.description: Implement internationalization for all navigation text and labels.
subtasks.details: Import and integrate the LanguageSwitcher component. Replace all hardcoded text with next-intl translation keys. Add translations for all navigation items in locale files (en.json, etc.). Ensure proper fallback for missing translations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test language switching and verify all navigation text changes appropriately.

subtasks.title: Implement Responsive Design for Header
subtasks.description: Ensure the header adapts properly to different screen sizes with appropriate breakpoints.
subtasks.details: Implement responsive layout using Tailwind CSS breakpoints. Show/hide appropriate components based on screen size. Create smooth transitions between desktop and mobile views. Test and adjust layout for common device sizes. Ensure no horizontal overflow on small screens.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test on multiple screen sizes and verify correct component visibility and layout.

subtasks.title: Add Keyboard Navigation Support
subtasks.description: Implement full keyboard navigation support for all header components.
subtasks.details: Add proper tabIndex attributes to all interactive elements. Implement keyboard shortcuts for common actions. Ensure focus trapping in dropdowns and mobile menu. Add visible focus indicators. Test tab order for logical navigation flow.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test complete navigation using only keyboard to verify all functions are accessible.

subtasks.title: Implement ARIA Attributes for Accessibility
subtasks.description: Add proper ARIA roles and attributes to ensure screen reader compatibility.
subtasks.details: Add aria-label, aria-expanded, aria-controls attributes where appropriate. Implement aria-current for active navigation items. Add proper role attributes to navigation elements. Ensure screen reader announcements for dynamic content changes. Add aria-hidden to decorative elements.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with screen readers to verify proper announcements and navigation.

subtasks.title: Integrate Header with Layout
subtasks.description: Update the main layout to include the header component with proper positioning.
subtasks.details: Update `app/[locale]/layout.tsx` to include the Header component. Implement sticky header behavior with smooth scroll effects. Ensure proper z-index management. Add appropriate spacing between header and main content. Handle potential layout shifts during navigation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify header appears correctly on all pages and maintains position during scrolling.

subtasks.title: Implement Visual Feedback and Hover States
subtasks.description: Add visual feedback for interactive elements including hover, focus, and active states.
subtasks.details: Implement hover effects for navigation items using Tailwind CSS. Add transition animations for smooth state changes. Create active indicators for current route. Ensure sufficient color contrast for all states. Implement loading states for asynchronous actions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test all interactive elements to verify proper visual feedback for all states.

subtasks.title: Conduct Final Integration Testing
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing of the entire header navigation system.
subtasks.details: Test integration with authentication system. Verify internationalization works correctly. Test responsive behavior across device sizes. Validate accessibility compliance. Check performance for animations and transitions. Ensure consistent behavior across browsers. Document any edge cases or known limitations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create a test matrix covering all features, states, and device sizes to ensure complete coverage.
